tasks.short: Observe winding and remove loaded bobbins.

steps.what: Observe bobbins as they are winding to identify actual loading and thread condition
Cut threads with the knife under the existing machine safety procedure and physically remove the loaded bobbin

tasks.design: Retain observation, safe thread cutting and physical bobbin removal with the operator. A records application does not perform this handling, and new winding machinery is outside this software proposal.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is visual monitoring and physical handling.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied digital capability removes the actual handling.
tasks.still_hard: Recognizing a loaded bobbin and working safely near winding equipment.
tasks.human_edge: Direct awareness of thread and machine condition.

ambition.what: No faster handling or new production capacity is assumed.

evidence.claim: Digital production records do not themselves observe, cut or remove physical bobbins.

assumptions: Boundary is watching winding and cutting/removing bobbins. The statement contains no separate work record, report, lookup or send, and none is hidden within the physical step. Any actual production record belongs once to its record-keeping task.
Actual loading and thread condition are observed by the operator in s1; no scheduled count is treated as observed production. No structured input feed is assumed.

Existing machine safety procedures remain. Physical cutting/removal uses write_internal for material handling, not a digital commit; no automated actuation is proposed. No system change means zero incremental upkeep.
The digest's machine-record collection and cutting-marker layout do not change this handling task. Native settings are already part of the machine baseline and earn no labour saving.
research_questions: Is there an actual machine-handling improvement outside this software boundary?

already_counted.description: All actual observation and handling remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Visual monitoring and physical cutting/removal remain unchanged; production-record software offers no established saving here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study guides, samples, charts and specification sheets for the actual textile and machine setup
Confer with supervisors or engineering staff to resolve unclear setup requirements and sample differences
Determine the setup requirements by reconciling the actual sample, specifications and clarified instructions

tasks.design: Keep actual guide and sample study and setup clarification with the operator, using existing instructions in {DOCS}. The record and nesting tools in the digest do not determine safe winding, twisting or drawing settings from an unfamiliar sample.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on interpreting the actual textile and machine instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional capability in the supplied digest establishes a change to this task.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling sample behavior with specifications and machine limits.
tasks.human_edge: Textile handling experience and asking the right clarification.

ambition.what: No automatic setup or extra throughput is assumed.

evidence.claim: Production records and cutting-marker tools do not establish the correct winding or drawing setup for a particular textile sample.

assumptions: Boundary is studying, conferring and determining requirements, not changing machine settings or writing a production record. Document reading is explicitly separate from conversation; no report or send is hidden in either.

Engineering supplies machine ID, guide revision, material specification and setup chart; the operator supplies the actual sample comparison. Missing or conflicting instructions are resolved through the counted conversation, not inferred by a model.

Native document viewing and existing charts are the baseline, with no invented repeated search or arithmetic. No new system means zero upkeep. Physical setup and any subsequent record belong to their actual tasks and receive no saving here.
unknowns: How often instructions are incomplete or samples differ.
research_questions: Is there a repeated fixed calculation actually performed before proposing a setup calculator?

already_counted.description: Guide study, clarification and setup judgement remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No system change or ongoing upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All actual reading, sample interpretation and clarification remain. Existing charts are not a new saving and no repeated admin baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Continue hands-on textile operation and setup judgement.
reach: Explain machine-specific handling and setup uncertainties to process technicians.
role.ambitious_version: An operator who resolves actual setup uncertainties before machine operation.

job.title: Textile Winding, Twisting, and Drawing Out Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
